currentAnnouncement.message: Casualties Hub v0.0.8 is actively in the works, with UI refinements, new customization options, and fixes based on community feedback. Follow progress and catch the latest updates on the official Casualties Hub Discord — join us to stay in the loop.

previousAnnouncements.message: Casualties Hub v0.0.8-pre.1 is now in testing. Hub announcements and update information are moving from Supabase to a privacy-friendly GitHub-hosted feed.
Casualties Hub v0.0.7 is the current public release.
